title: ContainerPinReceipt
description: Spec 002 R-N001: the NGC image a training or inference process ran in, pinned by digest. Payload of an ArtifactEnvelope. DRAFT.

source.description: Registry host. Only NGC images are pinned (R-N001).

repository.description: Repository path under nvcr.io, for example nvidia/pytorch.

tag.description: Human-readable tag. The digest, not the tag, is the pin.

capture_method.description: How the digest was read: image inspect RepoDigests, host-side container inspect of the run, or the launcher-set BLACKDOG_CONTAINER_IMAGE claim.

host_fingerprint_digest.description: Content digest of the host environment-diagnostics artifact (R-001), when known. Also listed in parents.
